name: Silent milestone film: dips to black between sections, a headline over flashing backgrounds, a counter to one million

source.location: external: user reference folder (resolve with --root or MOTION_REFERENCE_ROOTS); never copied into the repository
source.creator: unknown

rights.attribution: Unknown creator; supplied by the user as a private study reference.

brand_assets.description: Screenshots of third-party websites and their imagery

rights.notes: Rights unverified. Product milestone film full of third-party website screenshots; reuse the dip rhythm, the held-headline montage and the counter-plus-chart only.

analysis.inspected_by: agent (GitHub Copilot, session B) using the reference-analyst workflow
analysis.method: Viewed overview (64 frames) and the transitions sheet (all 11 boundaries, every 2nd frame); 30 fps strips 2.20-2.80, 16.50-18.40 and 38.55-39.15 s and a 15 fps strip 42.00-43.80 s. No audio track, so no audio panel or listen sheet (listen reports no audio track). Nothing was listened to.
analysis.coverage: Full 54.3 s; every boundary on the sheet; the dips, the background montage, the word swap and the letter reveal at 15-30 fps.

concept.observed: A silent milestone announcement for a website-template product: a tilted wall of sites, a claim, a terminal command, the launch, a headline held while backgrounds flash, a counter rolling to one million over a rising chart, a grid of sites with a headline, a 'to every' line with a swapped role word, a thank-you and a starfield end card.
concept.interpreted: Gratitude built from proof (the sites) and one number; with no sound, pace and emphasis come only from holds, dips and type.

communication_style.observed: Short centred headlines in a light sans with pink-to-violet gradient key words; small pill kickers above headlines; no voice and no audio track.

palette.observed: Black (#080808, 80%) with pink-violet gradient type and full-colour site screenshots; mean luma 0.09.

typography.observed: Thin and regular grotesk; key word in a gradient; tabular digits for the counter.

composition.observed: Centred headline on black; headline top-left over a full-bleed grid of sites (30.1-33.5 s); small kicker above a large single word (35-41 s).

motion.observed: Terminal typing (6.4-10.6 s); odometer digits roll 18.30-22.48 s while an area chart draws; slow drift over the tilted site wall; floating cards at different depths with blur (35-41 s).

transitions.observed: 11 boundaries, all soft. 0.58 and 29.25 s: camera drift over the site wall (continuous). 2.40, 5.67, 25.57, 34.23 and 40.92 s: dips to the black background; content fades out in 0.2-0.3 s, black holds 0.05-0.13 s (0.7 s before the closing section at 41.27-42.0 s), then the next kicker or headline types or fades in (continuous, dip). 16.92 and 17.92 s: inside a 1.5 s run (16.67-18.13 s) where the headline holds and the background image changes every 2-4 frames (0.07-0.13 s), a cut montage under persistent type. 37.25 and 38.67 s: in-place word swaps, the large word blurring out while the next blurs in over about 0.25 s (38.75-39.02 s; continuous). Not detected: 18.27-18.30 s the headline fades and the counter appears in place; 46.24-47.09 s the thank-you fades and the mark appears.
transitions.interpreted: On a black canvas the dip is the section break; the only cut energy is the background montage, used once, right before the big number.

timing_and_rhythm.observed: Sections of 3-9 s; median scene 3.15 s; static holds 7.58-9.42, 13.92-14.92 and 44.75-45.75 s.

depth_and_layering.observed: Tilted wall of site cards; floating cards with depth blur behind the swapped word.

sound_design.observed: No audio track (listen: no audio track); nothing to measure. The film is built to work muted.
sound_design.interpreted: A muted-autoplay reference: rhythm is carried by holds and dips alone.

captions.observed: None; copy lives in centred one-line headlines of 2-5 words, a top-left headline that builds word by word over the site grid (30.1-31.8 s) and small pill kickers above section titles.

scenes.observed: A tilted wall of website screenshots drifts.
Kicker pill, then a two-line claim over a strip of sites.
A 'one command' headline beside a terminal that types a command.
A 'we launched' kicker and the product wordmark.
A two-word headline holds while backgrounds flash behind it.
A counter rolls to one million over a rising area chart.
A grid of sites rises; a headline builds top-left.
'To every' with a swapped role word among floating cards.
'Building with us' and a letter-by-letter blur reveal of a thank-you.
Mark, wordmark and a starfield end card.

moments.observed: The headline holds while 14 different site backgrounds flash behind it, each 2-4 frames (0.07-0.13 s), for 1.5 s; then the headline fades and the counter takes over.
moments.interpreted: The montage says 'many' without a number; then the counter says how many.

moments.observed: The thank-you line appears letter by letter, each letter going from blurred and transparent to sharp, about 0.07 s apart, in 1.1 s (42.47-43.53 s).

uncertainties: Whether the film was published silent or the audio was removed before it reached us
The odometer's exact easing (the scan samples at 6 fps)

sampling.cut_refinement: every frame inside the coarse step
